short_description: Private, captain-led customizable boat tour around Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands with a Florida-certified naturalist guide.
description: Enjoy a private boat tour of Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands with your own captain and a Florida-certified naturalist guide. Design your ideal outing—sightseeing, local history, eco-focused exploration, dolphin watching, or dedicated shelling—then relax while the crew handles navigation and local insights. The experience is tailored to your group’s interests, offering a flexible, immersive way to see mangroves, islands, and wildlife with the privacy of a chartered vessel.

what_is_not_included_items.value: Drinks (guests must bring their own; alcohol allowed but no red wine)

highlights:
* Private boat with your own captain
* Florida-certified naturalist guide
* Customizable tour options: sightseeing, history, eco-tour, dolphins, shelling
* Explore Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands
check_in_details:
- Free parking is available across the street from Stan's Idle Hour Restaurant in the gravel lot behind the white fence. 
- Boats are located on the private dock behind the company banner and flags. 
- Please use the bathrooms at Stan's (yellow building) before boarding.

what_to_bring_items.value: Drinks (Yes, you can bring alcohol but NO RED WINE)
Towel (to sit on or if you go swimming)
Camera or smartphone to take pictures!

disclaimers:
No restroom on board; guests should use the facilities at Stan's Idle Hour Restaurant before boarding. 
Alcohol is allowed but red wine is prohibited. 
Gratuities for captain and crew are not included.
